hardcodedOpenAIKey.title: Hardcoded OpenAI API key
hardcodedOpenAIKey.description: Hardcoded OpenAI API key found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedOpenAIKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedAnthropicKey.title: Hardcoded Anthropic API key
hardcodedAnthropicKey.description: Hardcoded Anthropic API key found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedAnthropicKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedGitHubPat.title: Hardcoded GitHub PAT
hardcodedGitHubPat.description: Hardcoded GitHub PAT found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedGitHubPat.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedGoogleKey.title: Hardcoded Google API key
hardcodedGoogleKey.description: Hardcoded Google API key found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedGoogleKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedAWSKey.title: Hardcoded AWS access key
hardcodedAWSKey.description: Hardcoded AWS access key found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedAWSKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

embeddedPrivateKey.title: Embedded private key
embeddedPrivateKey.description: Embedded private key found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
embeddedPrivateKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedCred.title: Hardcoded credential in assignment
hardcodedCred.description: Credential assigned as literal at line {line}.

jwtNoneAlgorithm.title: JWT 'none' algorithm
jwtNoneAlgorithm.recommendation: Specify allowed algorithms (HS256, RS256). Never accept 'none'.

weakMd5.title: Weak MD5 hashing
weakMd5.recommendation: Migrate to bcrypt/argon2 with work factor >= 12.

sqlInjection.title: Potential SQL Injection
sqlInjection.description: User input interpolated into SQL query.
sqlInjection.recommendation: Use parameterized queries. Never interpolate user input.

pathTraversal.title: Potential Path Traversal
pathTraversal.recommendation: Validate paths with path.resolve(). Verify within allowed dir.

ssrf.title: Potential SSRF
ssrf.recommendation: Validate URLs against allowlist. Block internal IPs.

unsafeEval.title: Unsafe eval() usage
unsafeEval.recommendation: Replace with JSON.parse or safe alternative.

openRedirect.title: Potential Open Redirect
openRedirect.recommendation: Validate against allowlist of trusted domains.

nullDeref.title: Potential null dereference
nullDeref.description: ctx.user accessed without null check at line {line}.

missingDeps.title: Missing useEffect dependency array
missingDeps.description: useEffect without dependency array runs on every render.

asyncStateAfterUnmount.title: Async state update after unmount
asyncStateAfterUnmount.description: async useEffect may set state after unmount.
asyncStateAfterUnmount.recommendation: Use AbortController or a mounted flag.

looseEquality.title: Loose equality (==)
looseEquality.description: == does type coercion, may cause bugs.

consoleLog.title: console.log in production code
consoleLog.recommendation: Remove or replace with a proper logger.

varInsteadOfLetConst.title: var instead of let/const
varInsteadOfLetConst.description: var has function scope, not block scope.

missingAwait.title: Missing await before async call
missingAwait.description: Async function called without await — promise may not resolve.

infiniteLoop.title: Potential infinite loop
infiniteLoop.recommendation: Add a break condition or limit iterations.

unusedVariable.title: Unused variable: {name}
unusedVariable.recommendation: Remove the unused variable or prefix with _ if intentional.

lodashFull.title: Entire lodash imported
lodashFull.description: Importing all of lodash ships ~70KB to client.
lodashFull.recommendation: Use 'import debounce from lodash/debounce' or switch to es-toolkit.

underscore.title: underscore imported
underscore.description: underscore adds ~60KB. Use individual lodash/es modules or native JS.
underscore.recommendation: Use individual lodash/es modules or native JS.

rxjsFull.title: Full rxjs import
rxjsFull.description: Importing all of rxjs is huge. Use 'import { map } from rxjs/operators'.

antdFull.title: antd full import without tree-shaking
antdFull.description: antd may bundle unused components. Use babel-plugin-import or individual imports.

barrelFile.title: Barrel file with many re-exports
barrelFile.description: index.ts re-exports many modules — prevents tree-shaking.
barrelFile.recommendation: Split barrel file or use direct imports.

expensiveComputation.title: Expensive computation in render
expensiveComputation.description: Array sort/filter/reduce in render without useMemo.
expensiveComputation.recommendation: Wrap in useMemo with proper dependencies.

handlerNotMemoized.title: Handler not memoized
handlerNotMemoized.description: Function handler created inline and passed to child — causes re-renders.

useStateObjectSpread.title: useState object spread
useStateObjectSpread.description: Spreading state object on every update is wasteful. Use separate useState or useReducer.
useStateObjectSpread.recommendation: Use individual useState hooks or useReducer for complex state.

multipleInlineStyles.title: Multiple inline style objects
multipleInlineStyles.description: Dynamic style objects create new references each render — causes re-renders.
multipleInlineStyles.recommendation: Move static styles to CSS classes or useMemo.

componentNotMemoized.title: Component not wrapped in React.memo
componentNotMemoized.description: Exported component will re-render on every parent render.
componentNotMemoized.recommendation: Wrap component in React.memo() if props are stable.

largeFile.title: Large component file
largeFile.description: Component file has {count} lines — consider splitting.

missingKeyInList.title: Missing key in list render
missingKeyInList.description: React list without key prop causes re-render inefficiency.
missingKeyInList.recommendation: Add key={item.id} to each list item.

manyInlineHandlers.title: Many inline handlers
manyInlineHandlers.description: Multiple inline onClick handlers cause child re-renders.
manyInlineHandlers.recommendation: Extract to useCallback or define outside render.

sequentialAwait.title: Sequential await in loop
sequentialAwait.description: Awaiting inside a loop is sequential — slow for independent operations.

asyncWithoutAwait.title: Async function without await
asyncWithoutAwait.description: Function declared async but doesn't use await — unnecessary overhead.
asyncWithoutAwait.recommendation: Remove async keyword or add await.

consoleLogPerf.title: console.log in production
consoleLogPerf.description: console.log calls in production code waste performance.
consoleLogPerf.recommendation: Remove or use a conditional logger.

evalOrNewFunction.title: eval or new Function
evalOrNewFunction.description: eval() and new Function() are slow and dangerous.
evalOrNewFunction.recommendation: Replace with JSON.parse or a safe parser.

setTimeoutForAnimation.title: setTimeout for animation
setTimeoutForAnimation.description: setTimeout is not synced with refresh rate — use requestAnimationFrame.

heavyComponentNotDynamic.title: Heavy component not dynamically imported
heavyComponentNotDynamic.description: Heavy component imported eagerly — increases initial bundle.

imgInsteadOfNextImage.title: instead of next/image
imgInsteadOfNextImage.description: Using misses automatic optimization, lazy loading, and responsive sizes.

unnecessaryUseClient.title: Unnecessary use client directive
unnecessaryUseClient.description: File has 'use client' but uses no client-only hooks or event handlers.
unnecessaryUseClient.recommendation: Remove 'use client' to enable server rendering.

nPlusOne.title: N+1 query pattern
nPlusOne.description: Database query inside .map() — each iteration hits the DB.
nPlusOne.recommendation: Batch with findMany({ where: { id: { in } } }) or use includes().

unboundedQuery.title: Unbounded query — no pagination
unboundedQuery.description: findMany without take/skip loads all records.

syncFileIo.title: Sync file I/O in request handler

regexpInRender.title: RegExp constructed in render
regexpInRender.description: Creating RegExp in render is expensive.
regexpInRender.recommendation: Move RegExp outside component or useMemo.

setIntervalNoClear.title: setInterval without clearInterval
setIntervalNoClear.description: setInterval started but never cleared — memory leak + zombie callbacks.
setIntervalNoClear.recommendation: Store the id and call clearInterval in useEffect cleanup.

addEventListenerNoRemove.title: addEventListener without removeEventListener
addEventListenerNoRemove.description: Event listener added but never removed — memory leak across re-mounts.

setTimeoutNoClear.title: setTimeout without clearTimeout in effect
setTimeoutNoClear.description: setTimeout in useEffect without cleanup — callback fires after unmount.

subscriptionNoUnsubscribe.title: Subscription not unsubscribed
subscriptionNoUnsubscribe.description: Observable/socket subscription without unsubscribe — leak across remounts.
subscriptionNoUnsubscribe.recommendation: Use takeUntil, or unsubscribe in useEffect cleanup.

dangerouslySetInnerHTMLPerf.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML used
dangerouslySetInnerHTMLPerf.description: Bypasses React reconciliation and is a XSS vector.
dangerouslySetInnerHTMLPerf.recommendation: Sanitize with DOMPurify or render as React children.

lazyNoSuspense.title: React.lazy without Suspense boundary
lazyNoSuspense.description: Lazy component rendered without Suspense fallback — will throw if not ready.

nestedTernary.title: Nested ternary expressions
nestedTernary.description: Nested ternaries are hard to read and can cause unnecessary re-evaluation.
nestedTernary.recommendation: Refactor to a lookup map, switch, or early returns.

defaultPropObject.title: Object/array default prop value
defaultPropObject.description: Default {} or [] creates a new reference each render — breaks memoization.
defaultPropObject.recommendation: Use null/undefined default or define the constant outside the component.

largeInlineData.title: Large inline data in component
largeInlineData.description: Large array/object literal declared inside component — re-allocated every render.
largeInlineData.recommendation: Move static data outside the component or to a separate module.

useEffectNoDeps.title: useEffect without dependency array
useEffectNoDeps.description: useEffect without a dependency array runs after every render.

manyUseState.title: Many useState hooks for related state
manyUseState.description: {count} useState calls — related state should be consolidated.
manyUseState.recommendation: Use useReducer for related state transitions.

propsToMemoizedChildNotWrapped.title: Props to memoized child not wrapped
propsToMemoizedChildNotWrapped.description: Passing inline handlers to React.memo children defeats memoization.
propsToMemoizedChildNotWrapped.recommendation: Wrap handlers in useCallback with proper deps.

jsonParseInRender.title: JSON.parse in render
jsonParseInRender.description: Parsing JSON in render runs every render — expensive.
jsonParseInRender.recommendation: Parse once outside component or useMemo.

stringConcatInLoop.title: String concat in loop
stringConcatInLoop.description: Building strings with += in a loop is O(n²). Use array.push + join.
stringConcatInLoop.recommendation: Collect into an array and .join() at the end.

layoutThrashing.title: Layout thrashing in loop
layoutThrashing.description: Reading layout properties inside a loop forces sync reflow each iteration.
layoutThrashing.recommendation: Read all layout values first, then mutate.

domQueryInRender.title: DOM query in render
domQueryInRender.description: document.querySelector in render is slow and breaks SSR. Use useRef.
domQueryInRender.recommendation: Use useRef to access DOM nodes.
